verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for an online government filing portal, since such portals could ship a chatbot or agent for filings. The evidence covers only online filing forms, annual reports, payments, status lookups and browser support, with no mention of any AI assistant or task delegation. The robots.txt probe is unrelated to this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
